title: Full Cartier-adjunct uniqueness with canonical coefficient structures
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, n a positive integer annihilating R, i:Z to W a closed Cartier immersion, and n invertible on W. Use the canonical pro-etale sheaf coefficient structures [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and the existing cached small-Ext witnesses [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Define canonicalCartierClass to be the existing pro-etale class uniquely characterized by the full scalar-adjunct equation [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data], whose unique solution exists by [lem-sp-cartier-reduction-existence]. Any R-linear Ext^2 class e from i_*R_Z to the Tate line whose scalar adjunct is the pro-etale pole boundary followed by the positive Kummer unit equals canonicalCartierClass.

source.place: Cartier unit proof, full scalar-adjunct characterization, shared before diagonal specialization.

proof.text: Write the existing uniquely characterized cartierReducedPro class with an explicit Ext type using the canonical module-sheaf structures. This makes no new arbitrary witness choice. The named smallness and forgetful-additivity witnesses supply the canonical interfaces.

The assumed scalar-adjunct equation is CartierProReductionSpec after unfolding it and cartierScalarBoundaryEquation. Apply the pro-etale unique-witness component of cartierReduction_existsUnique to identify e with that class. The comparison is performed with arbitrary R,W,i before specialization.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_cartier_class_of_adjunct (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hR : (n : R) = 0) {Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hW : IsUnit (n : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (e : Ext.{u + 1}
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).obj (geoCartierConstant R Z))
      (geoCartierLine R n hR W) 2)
    (he : (Ext.mk₀ (cartierProIntegralGenerator R i)).comp
      (e.mapExactFunctor (cartierForget R W)) (zero_add 2) =
      (cartierProBoundary i (Etale.cartierPoleBoundary i hI)).comp
        (cartierProKummerUnit R n hR W hn hW) rfl) :
    e = canonicalCartierClass R n hn hR i hI hW
